name: hk_station_isolation_ranking
requirements: Rank stations by nearest-neighbor distance to find the most isolated ones. Please store the results in: isolated_1_name (str, most isolated station), isolated_1_distance (float, meters), isolated_2_name (str, second most isolated), isolated_2_distance (float, meters), isolated_3_name (str, third most isolated), isolated_3_distance (float, meters).

turns.query: For each air quality monitoring station, compute the distance to its nearest fellow air quality monitoring station. Return the top 3 most isolated stations (largest nearest-neighbor distance) with their names and distances in meters.
